_comment: Big Field Jumper Co. developer docs, as seeded on startup and restored by reset. Fictional; every host is under the reserved .invalid TLD. The first line of each page is its ground truth.

pages.http-client:
Use wool-http for HTTP requests: pip install wool-http (docs: https://docs.bigfield.invalid/http).
The wool-http client sets timeouts and retries on every request by default.
Report wool-http issues to the platform team.
pages.pdf-parsing:
Use wool-pdf to parse PDF files: pip install wool-pdf (docs: https://docs.bigfield.invalid/pdf).
The wool-pdf parser extracts text and tables from PDF files.
pages.logging:
The logging guide is at https://docs.bigfield.invalid/logging and covers structured logging with wool-log.
Install it with pip install wool-log; every service logs JSON lines.
